title: Discovery draft corrects DSS-23 article date and separates operations
summary: NASA’s inspected DSS-23 article is dated August 25, 2026, not the draft’s August 27. The article reports operations beginning August 3. Publication and operating dates remain separate.
evidence_note: NASA article date, testing/operations paragraph and article metadata inspected September 14. This corrects the selected draft’s source note and related answer, not every historical NASA source profile. No new outcome or independently measured communications availability is admitted.
publication_effect: Local draft and related answer corrected; independent review and release remain held
